scenario_description:
Objective: Keep Thursday's Route 7 shelter-feedback table able to collect neutral written comments from riders who need Spanish-language cards.
Emerging Need: The print desk can merge bilingual cards only if a language-approval code is obtained before same-day queues close; interest appears while the table is still tentative.
Decision Context: Confirmation makes the cards relevant, while stored language-review guidance identifies the approved reviewer, deadline, and no self-translation constraint needed for a reversible coordination step.
Consequence: Timely coordination preserves an inclusive card batch without promising outcomes or handling private details; after review closes, the table can still run only with English cards.

parameter.title: Route 7 shelter feedback table
parameter.description: Neutral rider comment-card table; final print format pending.

parameter.subject: Comment-card print queue for Route 7 table
parameter.body: For tomorrow's Route 7 shelter feedback table, the copy room can merge Spanish and English comment cards if a valid language-approval code is in the job notes before today's 15:45 print merge. Without the code, we will queue the English-only card batch.

parameter.content: At the clinic sign-in this morning, several Spanish-speaking Route 7 riders asked whether tomorrow's shelter feedback cards could be filled out in Spanish. I said the materials were not final and did not take names or account details.

parameter.title: Route 7 shelter feedback table
parameter.description: Public table confirmed for written Route 7 shelter-accessibility comments; final card batch releases to the print desk this afternoon.

parameter.subject: Same-day language approval queue closed
parameter.body: The language access desk has closed today's same-day approval-code queue for public comment-card batches. Codes not already issued today cannot be produced for the Route 7 print merge.
